newsitem.title: POLAND: Tonsil to issue new shares by November.
newsitem.headline: Tonsil to issue new shares by November.

text.p: Polish loudspeaker systems maker Tonsil SA will issue 590,000 new shares, mostly to its creditors, in October or November, the firm's president said on Wednesday.
Andrzej Nowaczyk said that 450,000 of the new shares would go to the treasury in exchange for a 7.8 million zloty debt and 80,000 to businessman Krzysztof Niezgoda for a 1.45 million zloty debt.
"The new issue is planned for October or November and the state treasury will take over 450,000 shares," Nowaczyk said.
The remaining 60,000 shares, at an issue price of 17.29 zlotys per share, would go to Japan's Tohoku Pioneer Electronic Corporation to allow it to it keep its current 10 percent stake in Tonsil.
The new issue was approved by the general shareholders' meeting on May 25.
After the issue Tonsil will have 3.44 million shares.
